title: Austin's 1883 Mayoral Election Results
summary:
• **Election Results Certified**: W.A. Taylor won the mayoral race with 1,135 votes, defeating P. De Cordova who received 918 votes—a margin of 217 votes across Austin's 10 wards.

• **New Board Elected**: Twenty aldermen were elected to represent Austin's 10 wards (two per ward), with results varying significantly by neighborhood, suggesting different voting preferences across the city.

• **Ward-by-Ward Breakdown**: Ward 7 gave Taylor his strongest support with 203 votes, while Ward 3 was most competitive. De Cordova performed best in Ward 2 (117 votes) and Ward 6 (74 votes).

• **Official Certification Process**: A three-person committee reviewed and certified all voting returns from the December 3rd election before the council formally adopted the results.
